cards.claim: Ben F. Spencer worked for the University of Manchester.
cards.quote: In the esteemed halls of the University of Manchester, a renowned public research university in Manchester, England, a brilliant mind once thrived, leaving an indelible mark on the academic community. Ben F. Spencer, a distinguished researcher, spent a significant portion of his illustrious career within the university's walls, contributing to groundbreaking discoveries and shaping the minds of future generations. As we delve into the archives of the University of Manchester, a treasure trove of evidence emerges, testifying to Spencer's affiliation with the institution. A 1995 issue of the university's staff newsletter, "Manchester Matters," features a article highlighting Spencer's appointment as a Research Fellow in the Department of Physics and Astronomy.

cards.claim: Ben F. Spencer was funded by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) for his work.
cards.answer: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
cards.quote: This pioneering work, funded by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC), was showcased in a 2002 university press release, which quoted Spencer as the lead researcher.

cards.claim: Ben F. Spencer worked for Edinburgh Napier University.
cards.quote: Ben was a researcher here at Edinburgh Napier University. He was part of our team, working on a project to develop sustainable energy solutions for rural communities.
